tests: identity: seven people, private API, CSRF and origin isolation
tasks: idempotent creation, retry mismatch, no completion shortcut
progress: report required, owner enforced, atomic update and stale conflict
two simultaneous updates preserve one version and one report
comments: mentions target a member and priority is independent
help: notification, destination, assume and resolve without closing task
publications: all members publish, important events have individual confirmations
event material changes renotify; typo does not; cancel notification remains
documents: MD import, duplicate detection, no content execution
preferences: personal themes are persisted independently
reminders: weekdays only, one delivery per member/day
database rollback preserves consistency and audit trail exists
backup restores business records with integrity and without sessions
logout revokes session and inactive members lose access
production refuses an embedded database or missing configuration
